justification: Inspected `core/src/main/resources/examples/PolymorphismTest.java` and `core/src/test/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/test/TestInnerClassRelationship.java`. `Quarter` is a tiny inner class at lines 26-32 with one public method, `deposit()`, and one responsibility: add 25 to `moneyBox`. It has no internal branching, no additional fields, and no extra methods, so there is no evidence of insufficient modularization in `Quarter` itself.
